verdict.rationale: Trello is a subscription SaaS, so whether a plan enforces minimum seats or annual billing is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack only names a "Free plan" for individuals or small teams. It never documents seat minimums, billing terms or annual commitments for any paid tier, so there is no evidence the product discloses these before subscription.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know whether my plan enforces a minimum seat count or annual billing commitment before I subscribe
